feeds.title: Kelley Keehn Blog
feeds.description: Kelley Keehn, a seasoned expert in personal finance, is a best-selling author, speaker, and media personality. With over eighteen years of experience as a financial educator and more than a decade as a professional, Kelley is dedicated to transforming Canadians' relationships with money. She has authored 10 books, conducted thousands of interviews, and spoken across North America, catering to individuals from all financial backgrounds.

feeds.title: Jessica Moorhouse Blog
feeds.description: Explore Jessica Moorhouse's personal finance blog for expert advice on debt, credit, budgeting, and more. As a money expert and Accredited Financial Counsellor in Canada, Jessica's platform has evolved into one of Canada's top financial education resources. Her focus is on providing support and guidance to millennials in an easy-to-understand, non-judgmental manner.

feeds.title: Mixed Up Money Blog
feeds.description: Meet Alyssa, the force behind Mixed Up Money, where money is more about emotions than numbers. Starting with consumer debt and student loans, she transformed her life, tripling her income, growing her family, and achieving homeownership. Alyssa's journey includes writing two books and connecting with amazing individuals, proving that financial success is within reach for anyone willing to embrace change.

feeds.title: Lyn Allure Inc Blog
feeds.description: Meet Lyn Allure, your business bestie and finance friend! As a content creator, Lyn serves business-minded millennial women, guiding them in designing and executing their dream lives. Her YouTube channel offers a wealth of content on entrepreneurship, financial literacy, self-improvement, and lifestyle, catering to those seeking holistic personal and professional growth.
